summary: Development launches now show the source tree's own version instead of a stale release-feed version, and a single launcher replaces the three start scripts.
details: The old no-console launcher pinned the splash and About version to the newest installer in E:\ArcRho Server\releases\installers, which stopped being updated when releases moved to GitHub, so dev launches were stuck reporting 1.2.5.
launch_arcrho_dev_mode.bat replaces start_electron.bat, start_electron_no_python_window.bat, and start_arcode.bat; pass arcode to launch Arcode.
The Electron host no longer falls back to ARCRHO_DISPLAY_VERSION when running in Arcode mode.
